Title: Prohibits the siting of battery energy storage system sites in residential zoned areas
Summary: Prohibits the siting of battery energy storage system sites in residential zoned areas unless the developer demonstrates there are no other reasonable alternative locations, including but not limited to, commercial, industrial and utility-owned properties; requires the department of public service to give an independent review of the application prior to municipal approval.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general municipal law, in relation to prohibiting the siting of battery energy storage system sites in residential zoned areas
